description: Engineer and administer enterprise Oracle Database environments, including Oracle RAC, ASM, and Data Guard, performing database configuration, maintenance, monitoring, performance analysis, and production troubleshooting.

Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), working with compute instances, virtual cloud networks, subnets, routing, network security groups, load balancers, and cloud networking architectures.
Deploy and operate containerized applications and microservices using Docker and Oracle Kubernetes Engine (OKE), managing Kubernetes workloads, application configurations, and production deployments.

Lead the development of Comdesk, an internal service management platform designed to replace traditional ticketing systems, contributing to requirements analysis, application architecture, database design, frontend development, and backend implementation.

Develop full-stack application components using Angular, TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, integrating REST APIs and implementing business workflows for service management and operational reporting.

Coordinate technical activities for Oracle Banking Digital Experience (OBDX) implementations at Banco del Austro, collaborating with Oracle consultants and engineering teams on architecture, deployments, integrations, and issue resolution.

Configure and administer Oracle WebLogic Server and Oracle HTTP Server (OHS), managing application deployments, middleware configurations, security certificates, and troubleshooting across development, UAT, and production environments.
Investigate and resolve complex infrastructure and application incidents across cloud, database, middleware, and networking layers, supporting the reliability and continuity of enterprise systems.
